notes: New: Dodge Enemy Ground Skills. Your character rolls out of enemy ground attack telegraphs, the circles that appear before an area attack. Turn it on or off in Setup; it is on by default. Saved Areas now draw a marker in the game so you can see your farm area. The Battle and Item pages are easier to read, with larger icons and text. This also fixes a freeze at the storage keeper and the multi client install button. Just update the app; nothing to press or delete.
